messages:
Alice Ramos: Heads-up: we're getting intermittent 503s on /generate in canary. Not spiking errors in prod yet but latency + retries are up. Can we do a quick war-room?
Ben Cho: On it — joining now. Setting up a bridge and a short calendar so we don't lose folks.
IncidentBot: [ALERT] 503 rate > threshold on canary (service/generate) — 12% over 5m. Incident ID: INC-2026-042.
Carla Nguyen: I saw the same from the frontend logs, some requests hitting a fallback model and timing out. Pasting a sample trace:
```
2026-03-17T10:01:22Z svc-gateway: upstream error 503 from inference-node-7
Trace: kv-cache-miss -> long-batched request -> OOM? -> retry
```
Dan Patel: I'm on call and can debug runtime. Ben, drop the bridge link and calendar invite. Also can someone confirm recent deploys to canary in last 30m?
Ben Cho: Bridge: https://meet.redwood.ai/bridge/triage-1779533210 (pin this)
Ben Cho: Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event?eid=triage-1779533210 (5-30m invite)
Alice Ramos: Deploys: rollout job r-2026-03-17-09:55 touched canary models (kv-cache changes + batching heuristics). I'm rolling back the model-backed change to rule it out, will comment when complete.
Carla Nguyen: Noted. I'll tail the canary logs and check memory pressure. Quick check command: `kubectl logs --since=5m -l app=inference-canary -c runtime`
Dan Patel: Good. If it's kv-cache related, we might see the OOM in /metrics. I'll run `curl -sS http://metrics.canary/metrics | grep -i oom` and share results.
IncidentBot: New comment on INC-2026-042: page_count increased from 4 to 27 in last 8m.
Ben Cho: FYI pinging infra to check node-level GCU utilization. @infra-oncall can you confirm?
Ben Cho: (added a short agenda in thread) Agenda: 1) Confirm whether deploy caused regression 2) Snapshot metrics + logs 3) Quick mitigation (rollback / pin / increase nodes) 4) Action owners + follow-up RCA.
Alice Ramos: Rollback started (r-2026-03-17-10:05). ETA ~2m.
Carla Nguyen: Seeing repeated `cudaMalloc` failures in runtime logs on inference-node-7 immediately before 503s. Copying small excerpt: `runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory`
Dan Patel: That's consistent with a different batching heuristic increasing peak memory. If rollback eliminates the problem we can attribute to that change.
Ben Cho: Infra replied in DMs: node saw memory spikes then kernel OOMs, autoscaler didn't trigger due to pod anti-affinity. They're manually increasing buffer nodes for canary.
Alice Ramos: Rollback finished at 10:08. I'm monitoring.
Carla Nguyen: After rollback, error rate dropped to 0.9% in the last 2m. Latency back to expected.
Dan Patel: Nice. I'll open a short postmortem draft with timeline and assign to RK for kv-cache heuristics review. Also recommend adding a safety gate to autoscaler or temporary override when canary memory climbs.
Alice Ramos: Agreed. Immediate action items: - Dan: postmortem draft + owner - Carla: add OOM alert for canary nodes - Ben: follow up with infra for autoscale rules + anti-affinity exceptions
Ben Cho: Will follow up. Adding notes to the calendar event so folks who missed can catch up.
Alice Ramos: Thx everyone. Closing war-room for now. If errors resurface I'll reopen here and ping. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-042 marked as mitigated by rollback (user: Alice Ramos).
